summary: To connect a project to source control, edit it under Automation Execution > Projects, choose Git, and set Source Control URL, optional branch/tag/commit (default HEAD), refspec, credential, and options Clean, Delete and Track submodules.
questions: How do I connect an AAP project to a Git repository?
What does the Clean option do on a project?
What branch does a project use if none is set?
When do I need a source control refspec?
